_note: Inputs for scripts/frequency/freq.py. Counted corpora are measured; references are listed in the output and docs only. 'dir' is relative to the cache directory (--cache, default ~/.hermes/cache/scratch/py-freq). 'commit' pins the clone that was measured; files are matched to the interview list by slug when they have one, else by id; freq.py refuses a clone at another commit unless --update-pins. 'key' says how a file maps to a LeetCode problem: 'id' = LeetCode number, 'slug' = LeetCode URL slug, 'title' = problem title turned into a slug, taken by 'regex' from the file name ('name') or its parent folder ('parent').
